`APIV1Service.SignIn` — `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`

That's the function containing the actual authentication logic, defined at line 51:

```51:51:server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go
func (s *APIV1Service) SignIn(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.SignInRequest) (*v1pb.SignInResponse, error) {
```

It handles both password credentials (bcrypt comparison plus a `DisallowPasswordAuth` check) and SSO credentials (via `resolveSSOIdentity`/`resolveSSOUser`), then calls `doSignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go` to mint the access token and set the refresh-token cookie.

Two related pieces of the call path, in case you need them: the Connect/gRPC transport entry point is a thin wrapper, `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` at line 78 of `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`, which wraps the context with a header carrier (so cookies can be set) and delegates to `APIV1Service.SignIn`. The RPC itself is declared in `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto` at line 24.
